title: Research: exact one-family physical host realization for selected PR589 (no new kappa)
body:
## Status

A finite exact operator realization check for one family in the selected PR589 nine-stage R439 bit allocation. No new κ; the selected certificate and `upstream/` are unchanged.

## Finding

The deterministic maximum-multiplicity mixed-child family is `(pair=1, copy=0)`, with four helper occurrences over idle children 0 and 7. The pinned schedule and selection are rebuilt from source.

- Child 0: one rank-8 helper at stage 1 plus a rank-6 idle remainder equals the source rank-14 pending map.
- Child 7: three rank-8 helpers at stage 5 plus a rank-4 idle remainder equals the source rank-28 pending map.

For each interval, exact rational composition of `D(P) = [[I-P,P],[P,I-P]]` matches on all 128 standard basis columns. All six orders of the three mutually orthogonal child-7 helper factors agree. Four controls reject an omitted helper, a duplicate helper, an equal-rank wrong axis, and a wrong source port.

This extends PR1307's all-family geometric projector census with an independent matrix replay for one actual mixed-child family. It does not import PR1307's checker. PR1334 prices relaxed selected-bit levers; PR1311 treats a different PR1122 word. Neither covers this family operator identity.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/seed03-bit-physical-family/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/seed03-bit-physical-family/test_package.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/seed03-bit-physical-family
```

Expected verifier output:

```text
PASS_PR589_PHYSICAL_FAMILY pair=1 copy=0 children=0,7 helpers=4 columns=128 controls=4 orderings=6 no_new_kappa
```

## Pins and limits

- Assignment: bit supplier, OS draw `2447174283`, seed `03`.
- Exact base: `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`.
- Selected record: κ `836330098538459/500000000000000000`; selected PR589 source commit `a5afc8c6169ea61ba7c51dfd3cade02cc7b13b46`.
- PR1307 predecessor head: `4cb255ef445e2abc3ff8845fa01210b974e2cf6c`; its `RESULT.json` blob and SHA-256 are recorded in `SOURCES.json`.
- Git blob and SHA-256 pins for all live inputs are in `research/seed03-bit-physical-family/SOURCES.json`.

This package checks one family's exact rational address operators under the inherited PR589 projector interpretation. It does not replay all helper scalar maps, all families, the complete interleaved caller, native lowering, all-size compilation, precision/tape, analytic transfer, or the multiplication theorem. No supplier adoption or κ improvement is claimed.

The optimized verifier, five focused tests and metadata/source-pin check passed locally on CPython 3.14.7. A Python 3.12 interpreter was unavailable locally, so the registered Python 3.12 replay was not run.
